comments.value: This issue is now confirmed fixed, thanks.

details:
VRC Version 1215
I already reported this to a friend who is a VRC dev directly via DMs, but I figure I should make a proper Canny about it as well instead of overly relying on friends to get my issues through.
I'll copy/paste what I told them to save myself time.
"I'm not sure if client stuff is your job anymore, but I suppose you could pass this to the relevant people in any case.
Currently, people who've blocked you in the room will come-up as users you've blocked in the "here" tab of the quick menu.
In fact, from what I've observed, it seems to assume someone is blocked when they first join until they load-in properly. So I think it's assuming anyone you can't see are blocked, or something like that. That's just my speculation though.
To be exact, it sorts the person to the bottom and makes their image black, but doesn't categorize it under "Users Blocking You" or "Blocked Users", just bottom sorts it, and if there's multiple people in the room blocking you then it stacks them vertically instead of adding them normally.
Either way, I know this isn't the behavior VRC intended unless you're the instance owner, which I'm not when this happens.
It began in the last version, I waited to report it in case it just got addressed in the next update, but I figured I'd report it now that it still hasn't been.
It doesn't mean I can see the blocking party, that particular bug seems to have finally disappeared with this last update as far as I can tell. (My personal theory on that is that having client users in the room probably interfered and created undesired results, and now that they're all gone it's fixed, but I can't say for sure).
I probably only notice stuff like this because I'm so sensitive about blocks and junk I guess, sorry if it's a hassle at all."
Attached are a screenshot and an output log that should only contain me logging into my homeworld and then going to the instance in question, because I explicitly logged back in on desktop just to get a proper capture of the issue.
Names in the screenshot are obscured for their privacy.
Thank you.
title: [1215] Users blocking me appear in quick menu when I do not own the instance.
